snippet.title: Sinner Maker // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4610100/Sinner_Maker

Sinner Maker allows you to create characters and simulate a society built around them. Construct homes, manage their needs, and watch as they fall in love, form friendships, and even become enemies. Manage resources and solve emerging problems if you want your soul to be saved.

Developed by
Pantokrator
